message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge label(s) for the described case.

Facts: Defendant Jiang damaged a segment of communication cable (public telecom facility) while excavating, causing interruption of telecom services for many users. The prosecution says "过失损坏公用电信设施罪" (negligent damage to public telecom facilities). The list includes a label: "破坏广播电视设施、公用电信设施". That seems to match. Also there is "过失致人死亡", "过失以危险方法危害公共安全", etc. But the specific charge is "破坏广播电视设施、公用电信设施". So we should output that label.

Check list: "破坏广播电视设施、公用电信设施". Yes exactly.

Thus answer: [罪名]破坏广播电视设施、公用电信设施<eoa>
